name: How do I choose the right contractor for my mother-in-law suite project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my mother-in-law suite project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for one with specific experience in ADU or mother-in-law suite construction. Verify their licensing and insurance. Review their portfolio for similar projects and ask for references from previous clients. A reputable contractor will provide a clear, detailed contract outlining the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. Communication is key, so choose a team that is responsive and transparent throughout the process. Ensure they are familiar with local building codes in your specific area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with ADU experience, verify licenses and insurance, check references, review portfolios, and ensure clear communication and detailed contracts.
